scope: Write docs/campaigns/user-rerun-decisions-20261006.json (user decisions 2026-10-06, docs/benchmark-decisions-20261006.md): attempts superseded by

rosario_kalibr_rectified_bundle.explanation: The attempt used the Rosario authors' released ORB-SLAM3 camera profile (virtual rectified intrinsics on unremapped image_rect_raw pixels, bf 32.270, zero camera-IMU offset). Decision (user, 2026-10-06): the complete published Kalibr stereo-IMU bundle as a rectified input (baseline 0.050240890825 m, camera-IMU transforms in the rectified axes, IMU on the camera clock by the published 4.098 ms) for every algorithm and mode.

imu_noise_rule_rosario.explanation: The attempt used IMU noise other than rule C (copied Basalt EuRoC values, the recording envelope or the raw calibration without the estimator's factor). Decision (user, 2026-10-06): rule C on every dataset with a published Allan calibration.

imu_noise_rule_citrusfarm.explanation: The attempt used the shared CitrusFarm recording envelope. Decision (user, 2026-10-06): rule C on every dataset with a published Allan calibration, CitrusFarm included (MicroStrain GX5 published values), for every inertial estimator including ORB-SLAM3; the envelope results stay as a separately labelled adaptation condition.

citrusfarm_vo_shared_file_changed_new_gr.explanation: Rule C changed IMU-noise fields of shared CitrusFarm files this visual-only attempt recorded (Basalt calibration, sensor profile, OKVIS2 VIO file read by SVO Pro). Its visual setting is unchanged, but the recorded hashes enter the cohort identity, so the cell restarts as one new group (user N=1-first plan, 2026-10-06); the attempt is preserved.
